info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Indigo Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Indigo Laptop Catalog Creation API enables businesses to efficiently create detailed product listings for the Indigo Laptop. This API allows users to submit comprehensive specifications, images, and descriptions that contribute to an organized product catalog. It is primarily targeted towards e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems looking to enhance their product offerings. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can ensure that their catalogs accurately reflect new products in a structured manner.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for an Indigo laptop. It accepts specific attributes related to the laptop and stores them for future reference.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the details of the Indigo laptop that you wish to submit. Ensure that all required fields are present and formatted correctly as per the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning detailed information about the indigo laptop.

CreateCatalogIndigoLaptopDetailRequest.title: Indigo Laptop Request Body

indigo_laptop_id.description: The unique identifier for the Indigo laptop.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the laptop.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the requested laptop.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier of the laptop.

warehouseCodes.description: The list of warehouse codes where the laptops are stored.
